translated_pages.text:
Department of Homeland Security
U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
I-797C, Notice of Action
THIS NOTICE DOES NOT GRANT ANY IMMIGRATION STATUS OR BENEFIT.
Receipt Number | Case Type
IOE0912345678 | I765 - Application for Employment Authorization
Received Date | Priority Date | Page
08/17/2026 | 08/17/2026 | 1 of 1
Notice Date | Applicant
08/24/2026 | SAMPLE APPLICANT
Notice Type: Receipt Notice
We received your Form I-765, Application for Employment Authorization, and the fee.
We will send you a written notice when we make a decision on your case.
Keep this notice. You will need the receipt number above to check your case status.
If you move, update your address with USCIS within 10 days of moving.
Please see the additional information on the back. You will be notified separately about any other cases you filed.

summary_title: USCIS receipt for your work permit application
summary_body: This is a receipt from USCIS (the immigration office). It says they received your Form I-765 on 08/17/2026. Nothing is approved or denied yet.
summary_body_en: This is a receipt from USCIS (the immigration office). It says they received your Form I-765 on 08/17/2026. Nothing is approved or denied yet.

demands.text: The notice date printed on this paper is 08/24/2026.
Keep this notice. You need the receipt number on it to check your case status.
demands.source_quote: Keep this notice. You will need the receipt number above to check your case status.

plan_steps.text: Keep this notice in a safe place with your other immigration papers.
Check your case status with the receipt number on this notice.
Ask a licensed lawyer or a DOJ-accredited representative what this receipt means for your work.

glossary.explanation: The code USCIS gives your case. You use it to check your case status.
The date USCIS uses to hold your place in line.
A letter USCIS sends when something happens in your case.

glossary.term_as_written: DOES NOT GRANT ANY IMMIGRATION STATUS OR BENEFIT
glossary.explanation: The receipt only shows USCIS got your papers. It is not a decision.

questions_to_ask: When can I expect a decision on my Form I-765?
How do I check my case status with this receipt number?
clerk_need_en: understanding a USCIS receipt notice and checking my case status
